nodes.rationale: Game-side rules, cooldowns and safe points; the game decides whether to act on service suggestions.

nodes.label: CameraAdapter
nodes.rationale: Refuses a second live instance: one capture, one inference pipeline, one producer socket, one consumer socket, one service session per enable period.

nodes.rationale: Narrow hooks so adaptation never applies an action in two places.

nodes.label: Camera support optional and off by default
nodes.norm_label: camera support optional and off by default
nodes.rationale: With camera off, no service request, no camera open, no camera code loaded; camera code lives in lazy chunks.

nodes.label: Frames stay in the browser
nodes.rationale: Privacy: only derived numbers are sent, raw frames never leave the page, nothing is recorded.

nodes.label: The game is the authority; the service only suggests
nodes.norm_label: the game is the authority; the service only suggests
nodes.rationale: Avoids double-applying actions; AdaptationPolicy calls one of three narrow hooks.

nodes.label: Loopback-only enforcement
nodes.rationale: Browsers expose camera only in secure contexts; remote use would need HTTPS/WSS, so remote is unsupported.

nodes.label: Single-sourced vision pipeline
nodes.rationale: Game imports CAMERA/web/src in place via dynamic import(); no copy or second implementation (replaces earlier patch-based integration).

nodes.label: Vision gate (visionUsable)
nodes.rationale: Vision-driven adaptation passes only when adaptation is on, service open and fresh, camera running, both sides calibrated, tracking valid and service gate active.

nodes.label: Vercel / Netlify static deploy of dist/
nodes.norm_label: vercel / netlify static deploy of dist/
nodes.rationale: vite base './' lets the build work from a subpath or root domain; no server-side routes.

nodes.label: Generate home appearance from room photos
nodes.norm_label: generate home appearance from room photos
nodes.rationale: Appearance matching within the existing house, not photogrammetry; floor plan and furniture fixed.

nodes.label: House layouts: hallway, row, openPlan, courtyard
nodes.norm_label: house layouts: hallway, row, openplan, courtyard

nodes.label: House templates (§11)
nodes.rationale: LiDAR unavailable; free-form floor-plan editor and photoreal reconstruction rejected (burden on caregivers, unaudited geometry, invented unseen rooms). Caregiver picks closest pre-audited template.

nodes.label: WorldSource interface
nodes.rationale: Largest risk was finding a verified walkable interior; defining the world as an interface with a procedural first implementation avoids blocking on it.

nodes.label: Adaptive resolution (texture upgrade, anisotropy, pixel-ratio ladder)
nodes.norm_label: adaptive resolution (texture upgrade, anisotropy, pixel-ratio ladder)
nodes.rationale: Nothing costs boot time (2k maps fetched after boot) and nothing is raised on a machine that has not demonstrated it can afford it; ladder never climbs twice so it cannot oscillate.

nodes.label: Network asset degradation to flat materials
nodes.norm_label: network asset degradation to flat materials
nodes.rationale: Every network asset is optional; texture/HDRI failures fall back to flat MeshStandardMaterial and null environment.

nodes.label: Rule F-1: no model call during a patient session
nodes.norm_label: rule f-1: no model call during a patient session
nodes.rationale: Keeps a patient session byte-for-byte deterministic given the same pack, preserving comparable §4.4 baselines and a meaningful check:offline.

nodes.label: Template mirroring in layout data
nodes.rationale: Never mirror with negative scene-graph scale: it reverses triangle winding, flips door swings and mirrors photographs/text.

nodes.label: Service runtime requirements (fastapi, uvicorn, pydantic, pydantic-settings)
nodes.norm_label: service runtime requirements (fastapi, uvicorn, pydantic, pydantic-settings)

nodes.label: Attention state (HEAD_TOWARD_SCREEN / HEAD_AWAY / UNKNOWN ...)
nodes.rationale: Stale observations yield UNKNOWN; a favourable value is never kept.

nodes.label: Suggested actions: delay_instruction, gentle_cue, offer_hint, increase_difficulty
nodes.norm_label: suggested actions: delay_instruction, gentle_cue, offer_hint, increase_difficulty

nodes.label: task_engagement_score heuristic
nodes.rationale: Not validated against any engagement measure; must not be used for decisions about a person.

nodes.label: Treat actions as suggestions; stale means unknown
nodes.norm_label: treat actions as suggestions; stale means unknown
nodes.rationale: The game decides; getLatestState returns null when stale and must never be read as 'looking at the screen'. Game must be fully playable without the service.

nodes.label: Difficulty follows performance only (no lowering from vision)
nodes.norm_label: difficulty follows performance only (no lowering from vision)

nodes.label: Null-with-reason measurements
nodes.rationale: An unavailable measurement is {value:null, reason} and never 0, so absent data is never mistaken for a real reading.

nodes.label: Gameplay event reporting (sendGameEvent)
nodes.rationale: Events kept until acked and resent with same event_id so retries are idempotent; player_activity makes inactivity reflect real idleness.

nodes.label: Camera assistance toggle (off by default)
nodes.rationale: With it off, no network request, no camera, none of the observation code loaded.

nodes.label: Role-separated producer/consumer WebSocket protocol
nodes.rationale: Separate roles so nothing echoes back.

nodes.label: Role-scoped 256-bit session tokens
nodes.rationale: Tokens travel only in Authorization header or WS hello, never in URLs, so they never reach access logs.

nodes.label: Memoria 3D camera-assistance patch README
nodes.rationale: Superseded in the unified workspace, where the game imports CAMERA/web/src in place; kept for standalone checkouts.

nodes.label: Completion outcomes: independent / cued / revealed / skipped
nodes.norm_label: completion outcomes: independent / cued / revealed / skipped
nodes.rationale: Four values never merged into a single score; revealed and skipped never counted as correct.

nodes.label: Hint ladder (three levels + skip)
nodes.rationale: Level 3 must not auto-complete navigate/find steps, which would skip the gameplay the metric measures; never shows wrong, red cross, countdown or score.

nodes.label: Pack validation reporting all problems at once
nodes.norm_label: pack validation reporting all problems at once

nodes.label: State machine: exploring | answering | paused | completed
nodes.norm_label: state machine: exploring | answering | paused | completed

nodes.label: Three.js exact version pin (r179+ API names)
nodes.norm_label: three.js exact version pin (r179+ api names)
nodes.rationale: Pin exact version with no ^ so HDRLoader/PCFShadowMap API eras are never mixed.

nodes.label: Memoria 3D Specification
nodes.rationale: Source of truth for the project; build prompts kept in PROMPTS.md so the coding tool never sees instructions for checkpoints not yet being built.

nodes.label: Navigate steps use containment, not entry events
nodes.norm_label: navigate steps use containment, not entry events
nodes.rationale: Relying only on a future room_enter hangs when the player is already in the target room, e.g. restart taken in the kitchen.

nodes.label: AGENT_TOOL_SCHEMA grammar-constrained tool calls
nodes.rationale: A 4B model asked politely for JSON sometimes answers in prose; compiling to a GBNF grammar guarantees shape (not truth, which the firewall handles).

nodes.label: Offline setup mode (local llama-server over loopback)
nodes.norm_label: offline setup mode (local llama-server over loopback)
nodes.rationale: Makes 'photographs never leave the device' a property of the network path rather than a promise about a third party.

nodes.label: Online setup mode (D-1, hosted Gemini inference)
nodes.norm_label: online setup mode (d-1, hosted gemini inference)
nodes.rationale: Trades the local privacy property for accuracy and nothing to install; enforced single destination and no-key refusal.

nodes.label: MediaPipe Face Landmarker (tasks-vision 1.0.1)
nodes.rationale: Frames never leave the page; WASM served locally not from a CDN; model SHA-256 verified.

nodes.label: Do not set VITE_GEMINI_API_KEY for hosted builds
nodes.norm_label: do not set vite_gemini_api_key for hosted builds
nodes.rationale: Vite inlines every VITE_ variable into the shipped bundle where anyone can read it.

nodes.label: Reasoning-before-calls prompt form (prompts.ts, version f-2)
nodes.rationale: Both authoring and environment design fail by answering too early; required reasoning fields declared before calls force the model to reason first.

nodes.label: D-2: serverless proxy for online key considered and declined
nodes.norm_label: d-2: serverless proxy for online key considered and declined
nodes.rationale: Adds a deployable component and a new trust boundary that sees every probe image; revisit when deployed for caregivers at large.

nodes.label: Mira and Raju fictional demo packs
nodes.norm_label: mira and raju fictional demo packs
nodes.rationale: Demo patients are fictional and labelled on screen; real patient content must come from a caregiver pack.

nodes.label: head_facing_score head-pose heuristic
nodes.rationale: Head orientation is not eye gaze; signals do not establish engagement, emotion, fatigue or cognitive state.

nodes.label: tracking_quality heuristic
nodes.rationale: MediaPipe gives no per-face confidence, so none is invented.

nodes.label: Hard product rule: never invent autobiographical memory
nodes.norm_label: hard product rule: never invent autobiographical memory
nodes.rationale: Every question, choice, answer and hint comes from the caregiver pack; the engine only selects and displays.

nodes.label: Simulation mode (labelled, not camera data)
nodes.rationale: For testing transport and policy only; never starts automatically, even on camera/model failure, and cannot run alongside the camera.

nodes.label: agent-audit.jsonl audit log
nodes.rationale: AuditEntry type has no field wide enough to hold image content or caregiver text.

nodes.label: Content firewall (validateProposal, rules F-a to F-i)
nodes.norm_label: content firewall (validateproposal, rules f-a to f-i)
nodes.rationale: Rule F-3 enforced by a pure synchronous function rather than a prompt instruction.

nodes.label: Prompt injection defence via caregiver allow-list
nodes.norm_label: prompt injection defence via caregiver allow-list

nodes.label: Agent may infer only visual, not autobiographical, image properties
nodes.norm_label: agent may infer only visual, not autobiographical, image properties

nodes.label: Rule F-2: the agent proposes, never commits
nodes.norm_label: rule f-2: the agent proposes, never commits
nodes.rationale: commitProposal is reachable only from a caregiver UI gesture and absent from the tool schema.
